title: CEO at First Solar

speaker: Mark Widmar
title: CEO at First Solar

speaker: Mark Widmar
title: CEO at First Solar
msg: These attributes are particularly valuable in the U.S. solar market, where FEOC-compliant suppliers who have domesticated their supply chains and localized their production capabilities provide the surest pathway to enable developers to realize tax benefits and to mitigate the exposure of project proformas to both the imposition of tariffs and the risk to project schedules associated with relying on imported products. A number of trade and policy developments over the quarter amplify these competitive differentiators. In August, the U.S. Court of International Trade ruled that the Biden administration's two-year suspension of circumvention-related anti-dumping and countervailing duties was unlawful, paving the way for possible retrospective duty payments on solar imports brought into the United States between June 2022 and June of 2024. speaker: Mark Widmar
title: CEO at First Solar
